dataset: A public dataset of overground and treadmill walking kinematics and kinetics (WBDS)
authors: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M
record_used: 42 subjects x 8 treadmill speeds; KINEMATICS = right hip/knee/ankle sagittal angle (RHipAngleZ/RKneeAngleZ/RAnkleAngleZ, 10 pts each) over the gait cycle; KINETICS = vertical GRF (Fz1) time-normalised heel-strike-to-heel-strike to the gait cycle (12 pts); 328 observations
note: The treadmill vertical GRF (Fz1, one belt) is used in the dataset's own force units; the fusion centres/scales each block so the ABSOLUTE GRF units do not affect the shared-structure analysis.
